text:
Staff Software Engineer / Engineering Manager — 12 years

Summary
Engineer who moved into leadership and still writes code. I have managed teams of 6 to 20 engineers, including two managers, and led backend platform work in Go, Java and Python. I like ambiguous problems at the boundary between product, infrastructure and operations.

Experience
Streamwell — Engineering Manager, Trust & Safety Platform (2021–present)
- Manage two teams (14 engineers) through two engineering managers; own the moderation decision service, report intake and the internal review tooling.
- Partnered with the ML team to automate 60% of first-pass review while holding precision above 97%.
- Ran the consolidation of three queue systems onto one Kafka-based pipeline.
- Hire and coach senior engineers and managers; built the team's on-call and incident review practice.

Paysquare — Staff Software Engineer (2017–2021)
- Tech lead for the payments risk platform in Java and Go; event-driven architecture on Kafka and PostgreSQL.
- Designed the rules engine used by the fraud operations team; cut false declines by 18%.

Kitebyte — Software Engineer → Senior (2013–2017)
- Built REST services in Python and Django, later in Go; owned the search indexing pipeline on Elasticsearch.

Skills
Go, Java, Python, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, ML-assisted automation, people management, hiring, incident management.

Education
BEng Software Engineering, University of Waterloo.
